metadata.title: Sign in - dados.gov.pt
metadata.description: Sign in to dados.gov.pt to access exclusive features. Share and reuse public data.

title: Authentication
description: Choose an authentication method to sign in to the portal and access the various online services and features.

cmd.intro: You need the PIN code of your Digital Mobile Key (CMD) and the mobile phone associated with it.
cmd.noAccountQuestion: Don't have a Digital Mobile Key?
cmd.discoverHowToCreate: Find out how to create an account
cmd.submit: Sign in with Digital Mobile Key

eidas.intro: You need a digital authentication method provided by your country of origin in the European Union (EU). This authentication method is available to any EU citizen.
eidas.discoverHowToCreate: Find out how to create an account
eidas.documentsPart2: that were issued by a public entity of
eidas.documentsPart3: of the EU? It is now possible to retrieve them directly from the issuing portal by signing in with your European authentication.

email.beforeStartDescription: Only existing users who created an account with email and password can sign in this way.
email.requiredFieldsNote: Fields marked with an asterisk ( * ) are required.

recovery.title: Recover password
recovery.description: Enter your email address and we will send you instructions to reset your password.
recovery.success: If the email address is associated with an account, you will receive an email with instructions to reset your password.
recovery.errorRequest: Error sending request. Please try again.

migration.title: Signing in with an email and password is being discontinued
migration.description: To keep signing in to dados.gov, you must link your account to your Chave Móvel Digital (CMD) or to European Authentication (eIDAS).
migration.migrateCmd: Link account to Chave Móvel Digital
migration.linkDescription: To link your account to {{provider}}, you need to confirm that the account is yours.
migration.errorMaximumAttempts: Maximum attempts exceeded. Account linking has been blocked for this session.
migration.errorInvalidCredentials: Invalid credentials. Check your email and password and try again.
migration.signInDescription: To link your account to {{provider}}, enter the email and password you use to sign in to dados.gov.
migration.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Validate by email
migration.successNewDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Once you follow it, sign in with your Chave Móvel Digital to access your account.
migration.enterEmailDescription: Enter the email address for your new account. We will send you a link to confirm the address is yours — the account is only activated after that.
migration.searchMyAccount: I already have an account — link it
migration.confirmationAlreadyDone: Your email is already confirmed. You can sign in with your Chave Móvel Digital.
migration.errorEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists, but it cannot be linked to this identity — it may already be linked to another Chave Móvel Digital. Use another address, or contact dados.gov.pt support.
migration.errorResendConfirmation: Could not resend the email. Please try again later.
migration.confirmationPendingDescription: Your account has been created, but the email address is not confirmed yet. Follow the link we sent to {{email}}, then sign in with your Chave Móvel Digital.
migration.errorNicRequired: The authenticated identity did not provide a civil identification number, so an account cannot be created this way. Please contact dados.gov.pt support.
migration.errorIdentityRegistered: An account is already linked to this identity. Sign in with your Chave Móvel Digital.
migration.errorTooManySends: The confirmation email limit for this account has been reached. Please contact dados.gov.pt support.
migration.linkSentDescription: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Click the link to finish linking the email to your account. If you cannot find it in your inbox, check your spam folder.
migration.resendLink: Did not get the email? Send a new one
migration.errorSendLink: The confirmation link could not be sent. Please try again later.
migration.errorTooManyLinkSends: We have already sent several validation emails to this account. Wait an hour before asking for another.
migration.linkErrorTitle: The link could not be validated

flash.linkExpired: The link has expired — it is valid for 30 minutes. Sign in again with Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS to get a new one.
flash.linkInvalid: This link is no longer valid. It may have been used, expired, or the account it pointed at may have changed since. Sign in again with Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS to start over.
flash.linkAlreadyDone: This account is already linked to your digital identity. Sign in with Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS.

migration.noCmdPrompt: Do not have a Chave Móvel Digital?
migration.entityDescription: If you represent an organisation and need help linking the account, get in touch.
migration.errorSessionLost: The linking session has expired. Sign in again with Chave Móvel Digital or with European Authentication.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.link: Terms and conditions for the processing of your data
terms.checkbox: I declare that I have read and accept the terms and conditions for the processing of my personal data in accessing and using the Reserved Area of dados.gov.pt.

help.title: Have questions?
help.description: If you need help, contact us through our form.

cmdModal.title: What do you need to create an account?
cmdModal.item1: For national and foreign citizens with an active Digital Mobile Key (CMD).
cmdModal.item2Before: You need the PIN code of your CMD and the mobile phone associated with it. If you haven't done so yet, you can
cmdModal.item2Link: activate the Digital Mobile Key at Autenticação.gov.
cmdModal.item3: Registration with CMD allows access to all online services provided on this portal.
cmdModal.createNational: Create an account as a national citizen
cmdModal.createForeign: Create an account as a foreign citizen

eidasModal.title: What do you need to create an account?
eidasModal.item1: Have an electronic identification mechanism issued by another European Union Member State that already has authentication infrastructure (eIDAS) available.
eidasModal.createAccount: Create an account with European Authentication

newAccountNotice.title: New account created
newAccountNotice.description: A new account associated with your Digital Mobile Key has been created. You can complete your profile in your personal area.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.requiredFields: Fields marked with an asterisk ( * ) are required.
resetPassword.requirements: The password must have at least 13 characters and include at least one symbol (e.g. !@#$%).
resetPassword.successDescription: Your password was changed successfully. You can now sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.errorRequest: Error resetting password. Please try again.

metadata.title: Complete registration - dados.gov.pt
metadata.description: Provide a valid email address to complete your account registration on the dados.gov.pt portal.

completeRegistration.title: Complete registration
completeRegistration.description: Your authentication (Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS) did not provide a usable email address, so your account was created with a temporary one. To complete your registration, provide a valid email address — we will send you a confirmation link.
completeRegistration.requiredFields: Fields marked with an asterisk ( * ) are required.
completeRegistration.mismatch: The email addresses do not match.
completeRegistration.errorRequest: Error registering the email address. Check the address and try again.
completeRegistration.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
completeRegistration.sentDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open the email and click the link to complete your registration. If you cannot find it, check your spam folder.

flash.alreadyTaken: That email address is already associated with another account. Please provide a different one.
flash.invalid: The confirmation link is invalid. Please request a new one.
flash.expired: The confirmation link has expired. We sent a new link to the address you provided.

errors.requiredFields: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.loginFailed: An error occurred while trying to sign in.
errors.samlStart: Error starting authentication ({{status}}). Please try again.
errors.samlBadResponse: Error starting authentication. The server did not respond correctly.
errors.samlIncomplete: Error starting authentication. Incomplete response from the server.
errors.samlConnection: Could not reach the authentication server. Please check your connection.

confirmEmailNotice.successDescription: Your email address is confirmed. Sign in with your Chave Móvel Digital to access your account.
confirmEmailNotice.alreadyDescription: This link had already been used — your email is confirmed. Just sign in with your Chave Móvel Digital.
confirmEmailNotice.errorDescription: This link could not confirm your email. Sign in with your Chave Móvel Digital again to get a new one.
